verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability for acting on many items at once, such as bulk tagging, deleting, editing, or re-scoring selected calls or traces. Running an Evaluation over a Dataset and the /calls/stream_query endpoint are batch evaluation and bulk querying, which are different features and do not count as bulk operations on items. Generic REST API access is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
